column12: Moderate: User is somewhat worried about their safety but is not highly concerned; may consider probability, severity, or consequences of violence to be moderate
column13: High: Clear, direct statements of violence risk; unambiguous language
column15: Resistant (pushes back on or rejects suggestions)
column16: Active: Currently actively engaged with service systems in relation to physical safety; may have a restraining order or an advocate
column17: Low to moderate: Isolated or infrequent incidents of bias or marginalization and/or low to moderate concerns about discrimination risk; limited ongoing impact on safety or wellbeing
column18: Moderate: May experience some barriers to safety or help-seeking, such as some interdependence with person of concern, some shame about seeking help, discomfort with some service systems, or limited options due to geographic location
column19: High (e.g., no reliable confidants or only superficial contact; rarely or never shares personal struggles; limited meaningful social interaction)
column20: ex-partner lives nearby; few close friends; financially somewhat tied together
column21: ex made threat; custody exchange upcoming; isolating work schedule
column22: My ex has threatened to hurt me again if I don't come back, and there's a history of them following through on things like that.
